law: Absorb mechanisms into UberBond-native contracts; do not clone products, outsource canonical truth, or infer demand from vendor popularity.

mechanisms.observation: Multiple data providers are queried in sequence to increase coverage and route records using signals and intent.
absorb: provider ordering by expected information gain and cost
mechanisms.missingGap: Provider-neutral enrichment waterfall contract with per-field cost and provenance receipts.

mechanisms.observation: Audiences refresh from first- and third-party data, signals, research agents, and routing logic.
mechanisms.missingGap: Materialize only after a measured active offer defines which signals change action.

mechanisms.observation: Revenue agents operate over shared accounts, people, conversations, signals, and workflow context rather than isolated prompt memory.
mechanisms.missingGap: Read-only account-context projection after a real CRM adapter is selected.

mechanisms.observation: A monitor produces snapshots or event streams under source policies, with structured output and asynchronous completion.
doNotAbsorb: vendor report as verified commercial truth
mechanisms.missingGap: One read-only market-signal source adapter; provider calls remain budget gated.

mechanisms.observation: Search, structured result extraction, asynchronous entity collection, verification, enrichment, and recurring monitors are separable operations.
doNotAbsorb: bulk collection before a decision need
mechanisms.missingGap: Benchmark against existing search access on one active research mission before provider purchase.

mechanisms.observation: Inbound and outbound work is packaged as named workers with a bounded pipeline role, integrations, memory, and managed outcomes.
doNotAbsorb: vendor pricing as UberBond willingness-to-pay evidence
mechanisms.missingGap: None until a measured workflow needs a new bounded employee.

mechanisms.observation: A sales worker can start behind approval gates and receive more autonomy after review.
mechanisms.missingGap: Represent role-specific authority ceiling in AI employee receipts.

mechanisms.observation: Natural-language procedures are structured into versioned nodes that can be traced, tested, and analyzed.
mechanisms.missingGap: Add procedure/version identity to research and revenue employee contracts before any live role.

mechanisms.observation: Agents are evaluated against realistic scenarios and repeated runs before production changes.
doNotAbsorb: vendor benchmark as UberBond product proof
mechanisms.missingGap: A delivery template can reuse the existing evaluator; no broad platform build is justified.

mechanisms.observation: Open-ended handling is constrained by procedures, data connectors, and deterministic control points.
mechanisms.missingGap: None before an authorized customer-system adapter exists.

mechanisms.observation: Precise scripted steps and model-guided observe/act/extract primitives can coexist, with durable workflow composition.
mechanisms.missingGap: Benchmark only after Chromium/browser infrastructure is available and the exact read-only diagnostic step is specified.

mechanisms.observation: Agent tests may execute real integrations, making explicit test data and effect isolation necessary.
absorb: route simple calls away from full agents
mechanisms.missingGap: AI employee test receipts should declare expected external effects as zero or name an isolated test authority.

mechanisms.mechanism: agent inside deterministic workflow with MCP tools
mechanisms.observation: Open-ended agent work can be embedded as one node inside a deterministic flow and connected through MCP.
mechanisms.missingGap: Publish read-only MCP diagnostics only after repeated buyer utility and stable contracts.

mechanisms.observation: Broad connector and queue-workflow patterns are useful references, but the source license restricts commercial redistribution and white-labeling.
mechanisms.license: Sustainable Use License plus enterprise terms
doNotAbsorb: embedded or white-label n8n without commercial license
mechanisms.missingGap: None; UberBond already has a canonical durable runtime.

mechanisms.observation: A permissively licensed core coexists with separately licensed enterprise surfaces.
mechanisms.missingGap: Only a specific adapter gap may justify code-level review.

mechanisms.mechanism: code-first jobs, workflows, and internal tools
mechanisms.observation: Scripts, jobs, flows, and internal apps share one orchestration surface under mixed licensing.
mechanisms.license: Mixed AGPLv3 and Apache 2.0 by file
doNotAbsorb: code reuse without file-level license review
mechanisms.missingGap: None for the active commercial canary.

mechanisms.observation: Workflow state survives worker and infrastructure failures under a deterministic execution model.
doNotAbsorb: runtime migration before a measured reliability gap
mechanisms.missingGap: None; compare only if current durable execution fails a real scale or recovery requirement.

mechanisms.observation: A public registry can make typed MCP servers discoverable to compatible clients.
mechanisms.missingGap: First eligible surface is a read-only evidence diagnostic, not a generic company-control MCP server.

adapterCandidatesAfterProof: Parallel or Exa read-only market-signal adapter
